behaviors.description: Tests without a recognized active assertion receive missing-assertion.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: The missing and dangling assertion fixtures return exactly missing-assertion with status findings.
Both test.skip and it.skip return exactly disabled-test with status findings.

behaviors.description: Active tests with recognized assertions remain clean.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: strictEqual, match, and toBe examples return empty findings with status clean.

behaviors.description: Malformed requests and unreadable files return a structured error with exit zero.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: Each invalid stdin case returns its specified error JSON and exit zero.
